25623792.belief: Only the 'leaders' of a community have a responsibility within it.
25623792.statement: Only the 'leaders' of a community have a responsibility within it.
25623792.correction: Communities are shared spaces and it is the responsibility of everyone within a community to make sure it is kept safe and inclusive.

255614912.belief: People with disabilities could solve their problems if they just tried harder.
255614912.statement: People with disabilities could solve their problems if they just tried harder.
255614912.correction: It's a harmful myth that people with disabilities face issues because of a lack of effort. The lives of people with disabilities can be improved by adapting the environment, removing barriers to their inclusion, participation and ability to thrive.

583434034.belief: People with disabilities need constant help.
583434034.statement: People with disabilities need constant help.
583434034.correction: With reasonable adjustments and support to overcome barriers, many people with disabilities can live independent and fulfilling lives.

656323428.belief: Paralympians only succeed because of their own willpower and determination.
656323428.statement: Paralympians only succeed because of their own willpower and determination.
656323428.correction: Paralympians need willpower and determination, but they also need support. For example, they might need funding for specialised equipment or coaching.

665580880.correction: Friendships can be diverse and can be in person and online.

672917528.belief: I can only be friends with someone I see a lot.
672917528.statement: I can only be friends with someone I see a lot.
672917528.correction: You don't have to spend lots of time with people for them to be good friends.

692946665.belief: A friend is someone who is always there for you and should be available to you at all times.
692946665.statement: A friend is someone who is always there for you and should be available to you at all times.
692946665.correction: It is important to remember people's personal boundaries and see friends as individuals with personal lives that are not always wholly interlinked with other's.

397819434.belief: If a friend falls out with me or we start to grow apart, I should do whatever it takes to make them my friend again.
397819434.statement: If a friend falls out with me or we start to grow apart, I should do whatever it takes to make them my friend again.
397819434.correction: It is natural for people to drift apart and discover different interests or hobbies, particularly as they grow older. It it important to remember that friendships don't last forever, and this is ok, you will experience other friendships in your life.

452086992.belief: The qualities of all relationships are exactly the same.
452086992.statement: The qualities of all relationships are exactly the same.
452086992.correction: Although all relationships should be built on healthy boundaries and respect, the qualities of a relationship can vary depending on who the relationship is with.

834665146.belief: Power in relationships is always unhealthy.
834665146.statement: Power in relationships is always unhealthy.
834665146.correction: Power comes into all relationships and it can be used to create safe, healthy relationships.

532586369.belief: If a relationship is positive, it will always be positive.
532586369.statement: If a relationship is positive, it will always be positive.
532586369.correction: In order for a relationship to remain positive, we have to be proactive and make conscious choices to keep the relationship positive.

141025405.belief: Good relationships just happen with the right people; it can't be a good relationship if it needs work.
141025405.statement: Good relationships just happen with the right people; it can't be a good relationship if it needs work.
141025405.correction: All relationships need work to make them succeed - even the best ones. We maintain good relationships by working through problems and having open communication.

822848592.belief: Fake news doesn't have an impact on real life.
822848592.statement: Fake news doesn't have an impact on real life.
822848592.correction: Fake news that contains harmful disinformation can be read and believed by people who unknowingly spread misinformation. This fake news often contains bias towards particular people or groups and can lead to prejudice when spread.

169574532.belief: Fake news is really easy to spot.
169574532.statement: Fake news is really easy to spot.
169574532.correction: Anyone can be tricked by fake news, unless they properly check the information that they see.

743663435.belief: All influencers are good role models who encourage healthy habits and sensible choices.
743663435.statement: All influencers are good role models who encourage healthy habits and sensible choices.
743663435.correction: Many influencers are good role models. However, there are some influencers that are bad role models because they encourage unhealthy habits or dangerous choices. This is often based on the controversial content's potential for financial gain.

193853847.belief: Consuming fake news has no impact on real life.
193853847.statement: Consuming fake news has no impact on real life.
193853847.correction: Fake news can contain harmful and hateful disinformation. This can lead to hatred, health concerns and can influence elections.

49895417.belief: The internet only exists for fun.
49895417.statement: The internet only exists for fun.
49895417.correction: Although online spaces can be fun, exciting or engaging, it also provides us with opportunities to learn, develop and grow.

313848470.belief: It’s legal to buy weapons, like knives, online.
313848470.statement: It’s legal to buy weapons, like knives, online.
313848470.correction: It is illegal to buy weapons if you are under 18, and many types of weapons are banned completely. Buying them can lead to serious consequences.

809629415.belief: If I see something harmful or inappropriate online, it's not my problem. I should just ignore it.
809629415.statement: If I see something harmful or inappropriate online, it's not my problem. I should just ignore it.
809629415.correction: Ignoring harmful or inappropriate content might seem like the easiest option, but it can allow dangerous or offensive material to spread. Reporting helps protect yourself and others, creating a safer online space.

836627244.belief: If a pupil reports ICT misue at school, they will get in trouble.
836627244.statement: If a pupil reports ICT misue at school, they will get in trouble.
836627244.correction: Reporting misuse of technology in school isn’t about getting people in trouble, it’s about keeping everyone safe.

199765311.belief: Nothing ever happens when you report something, so there’s no point.
199765311.statement: Nothing ever happens when you report something, so there’s no point.
199765311.correction: It might feel like reporting doesn’t make a difference, but action is often taken behind the scenes.

727915090.belief: It's not my responsibility to make the internet safer; someone else, like an adult, will do it for me.
727915090.statement: It's not my responsibility to make the internet safer; someone else, like an adult, will do it for me.
727915090.correction: Online safety is a shared responsibility for all internet users. Platforms have community guidelines and rules, and moderators work to remove harmful content, but they rely on users to report issues and promote positive behaviour.

710058937.correction: Some bacteria can cause illness, but humans need good bacteria for their gut health to aid in digestion.

436678912.belief: Self-diagnosis through internet searches is reliable.
436678912.statement: Self-diagnosis through internet searches is reliable.
436678912.correction: Internet searches can provide incorrect information. It's better to consult a healthcare professional.

75921261.belief: Brushing once a day is enough to keep teeth healthy.
75921261.statement: Brushing once a day is enough to keep teeth healthy.
75921261.correction: Brushing twice a day is recommended to effectively remove plaque and prevent tooth decay.

398561092.belief: You can tell if someone is healthy by their appearance.
398561092.statement: You can tell if someone is healthy by their appearance.
398561092.correction: Being healthy isn’t about how we look, it’s about how we take care of our body and mind. This helps us to feel good, have lots of energy, and do all the things we enjoy.

859984766.belief: Exercise alone is enough to stay healthy.
859984766.statement: Exercise alone is enough to stay healthy.
859984766.correction: While exercise is important, it must be paired with a balanced diet for overall health.

819837322.belief: It isn't ok to experience bad feelings. We should feel happy all the time.
819837322.statement: It isn't ok to experience bad feelings. We should feel happy all the time.
819837322.correction: There are no good feelings or bad feelings. It's normal to feel difficult feelings from time to time and there are ways that we can manage these feelings.

352074294.belief: If we can't find the right way to describe our feelings, we can't get help.
352074294.statement: If we can't find the right way to describe our feelings, we can't get help.
352074294.correction: There are lots of different ways that we can describe our feelings, including with pictures and metaphors. It's important to ask for help even if it's tricky to describe our feelings.

690018729.belief: Being quiet while someone talks and not interrupting is the only way to show you're being a good listener.
690018729.statement: Being quiet while someone talks and not interrupting is the only way to show you're being a good listener.
690018729.correction: Being quiet is just the first step. Good listeners also pay attention to what the person is saying, look at them while they talk, and try to understand how they feel.

674546830.belief: A conflict can only be resolved if we agree with the person we've had conflict with.
674546830.statement: A conflict can only be resolved if we agree with the person we've had conflict with.
674546830.correction: There are lots of different ways that a conflict can be resolved. In some cases, someone could agree with the other. In others, they could agree to disagree or agree to take some time apart from each other.

238847045.belief: Many pupils believe that the majority of their peers are smoking or vaping.
238847045.statement: Many pupils believe that the majority of their peers are smoking or vaping.
238847045.correction: In fact, the majority of young people in the UK don't smoke or vape. In 2023, less than 1% of 11-15 year olds reported regular smoking and less than 9% regularly vape.

748960660.correction: Vaping is not harmless as vapes contain nicotine and other chemicals that can harm the lungs and cause addiction, especially in young people.

533507974.correction: Smoking affects multiple body systems, increasing the risk of heart disease, strokes and respiratory illnesses.

430229866.belief: People should be able to stop smoking or vaping on their own.
430229866.statement: People should be able to stop smoking or vaping on their own.
430229866.correction: Nicotine is addictive, which means quitting alone can be very hard. Support from trusted adults, NHS services or community advisers gives people practical help and encouragement, making success much more likely.

213971398.correction: Cycles can vary in length between 21 and 45 days. Cycles vary most when someone's periods have just started (the menarche) and when someone is approaching the menopause. Cycles can also vary, for example, because of stress.

586664472.belief: Lots of blood is lost every cycle.
586664472.statement: Lots of blood is lost every cycle.
586664472.correction: Between two to six tablespoons of blood is lost each cycle.

801671951.correction: Anyone of any background can talk about menstruation. Make sure people who are most affected have the space to speak for themselves.

236268898.belief: All faith groups are the same.
236268898.statement: All faith groups are the same.
236268898.correction: While there are similarities, each faith group has unique beliefs and practices that contribute to the diversity of a community.

183674883.belief: Multiple faiths and cultures could lead to a loss of national identity.
183674883.statement: Multiple faiths and cultures could lead to a loss of national identity.
183674883.correction: Diverse faiths and cultures can help us to learn from one another and enrich our national identity.

461955800.belief: Only certain faiths and cultures face discrimination.
461955800.statement: Only certain faiths and cultures face discrimination.
461955800.correction: All faiths and cultures can face prejudice and discrimination. It is important to recognise that anyone can be targeted.

122723188.belief: Inclusion means everyone is treated exactly the same.
122723188.statement: Inclusion means everyone is treated exactly the same.
122723188.correction: True inclusion means giving everyone equal opportunities. Sometimes this means treating people differently to meet their individual needs.

541414268.belief: Kindness only matters with friends or people I know.
541414268.statement: Kindness only matters with friends or people I know.
541414268.correction: Kindness and respect are important with everyone, including strangers and people in public spaces.

529863849.belief: If someone experiences harm in public spaces, it’s because they didn’t take enough precautions.
529863849.statement: If someone experiences harm in public spaces, it’s because they didn’t take enough precautions.
529863849.correction: Harmful behaviour is always the responsibility of the perpetrator, not the victim. Safety strategies help reduce risk but do not remove blame from someone who causes harm.

884175195.belief: Just because someone is upset about banter, it doesn't mean it is bullying.
884175195.statement: Just because someone is upset about banter, it doesn't mean it is bullying.
884175195.correction: Bullying is an act that is intended to upset, banter is a playful exchange. The moment an individual feels hurt or upset by what is said, if the remarks continue it becomes bullying, as the intention is now to cause harm.

675347670.belief: Watching someone bully another person doesn't mean I am involved.
675347670.statement: Watching someone bully another person doesn't mean I am involved.
675347670.correction: Bystanders, when they accept bullying behaviour and do not intervene or report it, embolden the bully to continue as it creates passive support for their actions and makes the victim feel more isolated.

548180030.belief: Reporting a bully will make things worse.
548180030.statement: Reporting a bully will make things worse.
548180030.correction: Bullying will always be taken seriously. It is important that you speak to someone you trust about what is happening, whether it is to a trusted adult in school, at home or a national helpline service.

588101042.belief: It is acceptable to take, have or share sexual imagery of anyone over the age of 16.
588101042.statement: It is acceptable to take, have or share sexual imagery of anyone over the age of 16.
588101042.correction: Whilst the age of consent is 16, it is illegal to take, have or share sexual imagery of anyone under the age of 18.

508274890.belief: If I delete something online, no one can find it or see it.
508274890.statement: If I delete something online, no one can find it or see it.
508274890.correction: Even if you delete something you have shared online, others may have saved or shared it. Think before posting online and speak to a trusted adult if you make a mistake or feel unsafe.

571706983.belief: I will get into trouble if I disclose something that someone else has done.
571706983.statement: I will get into trouble if I disclose something that someone else has done.
571706983.correction: Telling a trusted adult about something serious someone else has done isn’t about getting anyone in trouble, it’s about keeping yourself and others safe.

907392972.belief: Everyone spends time online in the same way.
907392972.statement: Everyone spends time online in the same way.
907392972.correction: Each person explores the online world in their own, unique, way. We all have different interests and needs, and so we will all follow them in our own style.

292207584.belief: Looking at my phone helps me get to sleep.
292207584.statement: Looking at my phone helps me get to sleep.
292207584.correction: You may believe your phone is helping you to sleep, but without the blue light that comes from your phone you could get to sleep much faster, and have a deeper sleep. Try reading a book in bed instead.

776901839.correction: Many influencers alter their appearance or body shape and might engage in harmful behaviours to achieve a particular body type.

515811729.belief: Having lots of followers means a person is really popular and has lots of friends.
515811729.statement: Having lots of followers means a person is really popular and has lots of friends.
515811729.correction: Online followers are not 'friends'. Your friends are people you know personally. Celebrities and influencers can have hundreds of thousands of followers, the majority of which they do not know.

632997032.belief: If you are using a screen for learning, there are no negative impacts.
632997032.statement: If you are using a screen for learning, there are no negative impacts.
632997032.correction: Even if you are using a screen for learning, it is important to take regular breaks. Every hour, take a 5-10 minute break and walk around.

419566978.belief: Screen time is a relaxing activity and therefore should be prioritised after school or work.
419566978.statement: Screen time is a relaxing activity and therefore should be prioritised after school or work.
419566978.correction: Screen time can provide respite if we have had a long day at school or work, but we need to balance it alongside sleep, exercise, learning and socialising.

565254588.belief: If bullying happens online, it can't hurt the victim in real life.
565254588.statement: If bullying happens online, it can't hurt the victim in real life.
565254588.correction: Online bullying is just as harmful as in-person bullying. The effects of online bullying can spill over into real life and cause harm to the victim.

579566726.belief: Online bullying isn't as serious as in-person bullying because the victim can just log out of their digital devices.
579566726.statement: Online bullying isn't as serious as in-person bullying because the victim can just log out of their digital devices.
579566726.correction: Cyberbullying can have a lasting impact on a person's health and just because you turn off your digital device, doesn’t mean the feelings associated with the bullying go away. Bullying online or in-person is never ok.

580078831.belief: If I am not the bully, I've done nothing wrong.
580078831.statement: If I am not the bully, I've done nothing wrong.
580078831.correction: Witnessing bullying and doing nothing is also a serious problem. Bystanders often have the power to report or challenge harmful behaviour and protect those around them.

371303006.belief: People bully each other online because they are bad people.
371303006.statement: People bully each other online because they are bad people.
371303006.correction: Though some people are unkind online because they want to inflict pain, most do not realise the full consequences of their actions. Because people cannot see the impact they have on others, they can be less sensitive online than they are in person.

601706308.belief: Only vigorous physical activity is beneficial.
601706308.statement: Only vigorous physical activity is beneficial.
601706308.correction: Both moderate and vigorous activities are essential for health, offering different benefits.

902286239.belief: Physical activity solely benefits physical health.
902286239.statement: Physical activity solely benefits physical health.
902286239.correction: There are mental, emotional, and social benefits of physical activity.

586707510.belief: Talking about feelings is a sign of weakness.
586707510.statement: Talking about feelings is a sign of weakness.
586707510.correction: Anyone can talk about their feelings - everyone has feelings and talking about them is a sign of strength, not weakness.

204997050.belief: We cannot do anything to protect our mental health.
204997050.statement: We cannot do anything to protect our mental health.
204997050.correction: There are lots of things that we can do to protect our mental health, such as exercising regularly, forming social connections and seeking early support.

139850596.belief: Tricky feelings, such as anger or jealousy, should be ignored.
139850596.statement: Tricky feelings, such as anger or jealousy, should be ignored.
139850596.correction: It is ok to experience any feelings; however, it's how we respond to them that's important.

526518078.correction: Although getting stressed too often or prolonged stress can impact our wellbeing, some people thrive on a little stress as it can help them to perform better.

579261820.belief: Antibiotics are needed for all coughs, colds and flu.
579261820.statement: Antibiotics are needed for all coughs, colds and flu.
579261820.correction: Antibiotics are not effective against viruses. Most coughs, colds and flu are caused by viruses and do not require antibiotics.

463676659.belief: Allergies are just a mild reaction, they aren't serious.
463676659.statement: Allergies are just a mild reaction, they aren't serious.
463676659.correction: Some allergic reactions can be very serious and even life-threatening.

841325515.belief: All stomach pain is caused by food poisoning.
841325515.statement: All stomach pain is caused by food poisoning.
841325515.correction: Stomach pain can be caused by various factors, including indigestion, gastroenteritis and stress. It's important to recognise different symptoms and their potential causes.

734937894.belief: Only adults face consequences for breaking alcohol laws.
734937894.statement: Only adults face consequences for breaking alcohol laws.
734937894.correction: Young people can face serious consequences for breaking alcohol laws, including being fined or arrested if caught drinking in public or purchasing alcohol.

53452168.belief: Alcohol can only effect the body if consumed in large amounts.
53452168.statement: Alcohol can only effect the body if consumed in large amounts.
53452168.correction: Alcohol can impact the body even if only consumed casually. Alcohol impacts the brain and can lead to impaired judgement and engaging in risky behaviour.

746962991.belief: If someone becomes unconscious from drinking, they just need to sleep it off.
746962991.statement: If someone becomes unconscious from drinking, they just need to sleep it off.
746962991.correction: Becoming unconscious can be a sign of alcohol poisoning, which is a medical emergency. Immediate help should be sought to ensure the person's safety.

745428547.belief: Puberty is about changes to my body; it does not affect my brain.
745428547.statement: Puberty is about changes to my body; it does not affect my brain.
745428547.correction: Puberty doesn’t just affect your body—it also causes major changes in your brain. As your brain develops, areas like the amygdala and prefrontal cortex grow, which can impact your emotions, decision-making, and how you manage stress.

694991392.belief: A person going through puberty should not need the support of others.
694991392.statement: A person going through puberty should not need the support of others.
694991392.correction: During puberty, support is important. A trusted adult or medical professional can help with questions, worries and changes, so no one has to go through it alone.

396572458.correction: FGM is not mandated by any religion. It is a cultural practice, and many religious leaders condemn it.

156999752.belief: Virginity testing shows if someone has had sex or not.
156999752.statement: Virginity testing shows if someone has had sex or not.
156999752.correction: There is no medical test that can prove virginity. The hymen can stretch for many reasons.

447272214.belief: Forced marriages are the same as arranged marriages.
447272214.statement: Forced marriages are the same as arranged marriages.
447272214.correction: Arranged marriages involve family support in choosing a partner, but both people freely consent. Forced marriage removes consent and involves pressure, threats or abuse.

512051003.correction: Discrimination can take different forms, including direct, indirect, harassment and victimisation.

683532594.belief: LGBT rights have always been the same in the UK.
683532594.statement: LGBT rights have always been the same in the UK.
683532594.correction: LGBT rights have evolved significantly over time in the UK, with major milestones in recent decades.

345507491.belief: Civil partnerships and marriage equality are the same thing.
345507491.statement: Civil partnerships and marriage equality are the same thing.
345507491.correction: Civil partnerships (2004) gave many legal rights but were a separate status. Marriage equality (2013) allowed same-sex couples to marry on the same terms as opposite-sex couples. From 2019, civil partnerships were also open to opposite-sex couples.

44644749.belief: People in Britain can protest in any way they choose.
44644749.statement: People in Britain can protest in any way they choose.
44644749.correction: In Britain, the right to protest is protected, but protests must be lawful, peaceful and must not incite hatred or violence.

769858773.belief: We should alter our boundaries to suit what our partner wants and expects.
769858773.statement: We should alter our boundaries to suit what our partner wants and expects.
769858773.correction: Boundaries should be mutually respected. If our boundaries do not align with another person's, or they do not respect our boundaries, then a relationship is not healthy.

238979627.belief: Cohabitation provides people with the same legal rights and responsibilities as being married.
238979627.statement: Cohabitation provides people with the same legal rights and responsibilities as being married.
238979627.correction: Cohabitation does not provide the same legal rights and responsibilities as marriage or civil partnerships. It's important to understand these differences.

724275507.correction: While love and commitment are central to marriage, it also involves legal rights and responsibilities that have financial and social implications.

33371253.belief: Civil partnership is only for same-sex couples.
33371253.statement: Civil partnership is only for same-sex couples.
33371253.correction: Since 2019, civil partnerships have been available to both same-sex and opposite-sex couples in the UK.

524034747.correction: Grooming can occur in any environment, not just online. It can happen in communities and within families.

416842315.correction: Exploitation can be carried out by someone the victim knows and trusts, not just strangers.

321468813.correction: Sexual harassment can also be verbal or non-verbal, such as sending threatening messages or making inappropriate gestures.

153975417.belief: Feeling pressured is a normal part of relationships.
153975417.statement: Feeling pressured is a normal part of relationships.
153975417.correction: Feeling pressured is a sign of an unhealthy relationship dynamic. Healthy relationships are built on mutual respect and consent.

802189213.belief: Condoms can only be worn externally.
802189213.statement: Condoms can only be worn externally.
802189213.correction: There are different types of condoms: external and internal. Internal condoms are designed to be used inside the body.

302245588.belief: All contraceptives provide protection against STIs.
302245588.statement: All contraceptives provide protection against STIs.
302245588.correction: Contraceptives like the pill, implant, or IUD only prevent pregnancy, but only condoms protect against STIs, so relying on non-barrier methods leaves you vulnerable to STIs.

719661742.belief: Social media is a good place to find health information.
719661742.statement: Social media is a good place to find health information.
719661742.correction: Pupils should be cautious to ensure they use trusted and reliable sources of health information, such as the NHS website.

863160146.correction: Some STIs can be asymptomatic, meaning they show no symptoms but can still be transmitted and cause health issues.

839266341.belief: Only certain groups of people can get HIV.
839266341.statement: Only certain groups of people can get HIV.
839266341.correction: HIV can affect anyone regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation or socio-economic status.

79918189.belief: If you are under 18, sending or receiving a nude photo or video consensually is not illegal.
79918189.statement: If you are under 18, sending or receiving a nude photo or video consensually is not illegal.
79918189.correction: It is a criminal offence under UK law to create, send, receive or share any nude or semi-nude images of anyone under 18, regardless of consent or circumstances.

801691478.belief: The bodies seen in pornography are realistic.
801691478.statement: The bodies seen in pornography are realistic.
801691478.correction: Pornography often presents highly edited, staged or surgically enhanced bodies.

92365210.belief: Dopamine caused by online activity is always beneficial as it creates feelings of pleasure.
92365210.statement: Dopamine caused by online activity is always beneficial as it creates feelings of pleasure.
92365210.correction: Dopamine rushes caused by online activity are only short-term feelings and are not always beneficial as they can become addictive.

278928269.belief: Gambling online has different laws than gambling in person.
278928269.statement: Gambling online has different laws than gambling in person.
278928269.correction: It is illegal to gamble online or in person under the age of 18.

355592667.belief: Online abuse doesn't have real life consequences.
355592667.statement: Online abuse doesn't have real life consequences.
355592667.correction: Online abuse is serious and can have a range of consequences on mental and physical health.

725078128.belief: Teenagers lie in more because they are lazy.
725078128.statement: Teenagers lie in more because they are lazy.
725078128.correction: Teenagers' internal clocks biologically shift so they may sleep later than they did when they were younger.

345415665.belief: Exercise is more important than diet for good sleep.
345415665.statement: Exercise is more important than diet for good sleep.
345415665.correction: A balanced diet and regular exercise can both help someone to have good quality sleep.

602178395.belief: Each drug will affect every person the same way every time.
602178395.statement: Each drug will affect every person the same way every time.
602178395.correction: How a drug affects a person depends on the drug itself, the person's body, their existing health and other individual differences. The same drug can affect different people in different ways — and can affect the same person differently each time.

778460163.correction: Not all stimulants are illegal. Caffeine, found in everyday drinks such as coffee and energy drinks, and nicotine, found in cigarettes and vapes, are both legal. However, even legal stimulants can be harmful if used incorrectly or in large amounts.

743495948.correction: Depressants often affect a person's sense of inhibition first. This means they may do things they would not normally do.

358177488.belief: Psilocybin is safe because it is natural.
358177488.statement: Psilocybin is safe because it is natural.
358177488.correction: Just because something is natural, it does not mean it is safe. Magic mushrooms carry serious risks, including paranoia and unpredictable psychological effects. Every person reacts differently, so there is no way to predict what will happen.

606147243.belief: You always need to see a doctor for a sprain.
606147243.statement: You always need to see a doctor for a sprain.
606147243.correction: Not always, mild sprains can be treated at home.

617224218.belief: Cold water shock is only dangerous in very cold water.
617224218.statement: Cold water shock is only dangerous in very cold water.
617224218.correction: Cold water shock can occur in any temperature below 15°C.

284874029.belief: The recovery position is used for all unresponsive casualties.
284874029.statement: The recovery position is used for all unresponsive casualties.
284874029.correction: The recovery position is not suitable for casualties who are gasping for breath or have irregular breathing, which may indicate cardiac arrest.

54572310.belief: Our changing bodies must match up to the bodies we see in the media to be considered ‘normal’.
54572310.statement: Our changing bodies must match up to the bodies we see in the media to be considered ‘normal’.
54572310.correction: There is a wide range of ‘normal’ changes that take place during puberty. If a person is worried about anything relating to their body at this time, they can talk to a doctor or trusted adult.

617893310.belief: All women's health conditions are menstrual disorders.
617893310.statement: All women's health conditions are menstrual disorders.
617893310.correction: Women's health conditions affect different body systems. Some mainly affect the menstrual cycle, while others affect hormones or several body systems. PMOS is an endocrine condition, although menstrual changes can be one of its symptoms.

663342641.belief: Once menstruation starts, a female will get one period a month until they experience the menopause.
663342641.statement: Once menstruation starts, a female will get one period a month until they experience the menopause.
663342641.correction: Most menstruating females experience between 11 - 13 menstrual cycles per year. However, pregnancy, stress, weight fluctuation, holidays and hormone changes can all disrupt cycles and therefore not everyone experiences a period ‘once a month’.

808843187.belief: Everyone goes through puberty at the same time and in the same way.
808843187.statement: Everyone goes through puberty at the same time and in the same way.
808843187.correction: Puberty is unique to each person. Some changes happen earlier or later; both are normal. Respecting differences helps everyone feel comfortable and confident.

844180580.belief: Lots of young people carry knives, so all young people need to carry one to protect themselves.
844180580.statement: Lots of young people carry knives, so all young people need to carry one to protect themselves.
844180580.correction: Most young people do not carry knives. Carrying a knife makes someone more likely to be harmed, not safer. Professional support and practical safety strategies are available for anyone feeling unsafe.

906153298.belief: If I carry a knife or weapon but don’t use it, I won’t get in trouble.
906153298.statement: If I carry a knife or weapon but don’t use it, I won’t get in trouble.
906153298.correction: Carrying a knife or weapon in public without lawful reason is a crime regardless of intent. Police can and do take action even if the knife or weapon isn’t used.

420789994.belief: Carrying a knife is only dangerous for the person it’s used against.
420789994.statement: Carrying a knife is only dangerous for the person it’s used against.
420789994.correction: Carrying or being near knives puts everyone at risk, including the person holding it. Many injuries in knife crime happen to the person carrying the weapon.
